title: WebFailureOntology
description: Meta-schema validating skills/failure-diagnostics/references/ontology.yaml. CI runs this on every change to the knowledge base.

opportunities.description: Proactive recommendations emitted independently of any detected defect, so a clean audit still returns useful advice. These carry no evidence and never affect the readiness score.

match_mode.description: 'all': every listed signal must be present. 'any': a single listed signal is sufficient. Defaults to 'all' when omitted.

remediation.description: What the site owner should change, written for the brand's engineer. Used as the report's suggested_action when present; recovery_strategy/recommended_tool describe the auditor's next step instead and are only a fallback.

axis.description: Which brand-facing problem this failure mode belongs to. Groups the report by the questions a brand asks (why am I invisible / why is my info stale / why do referrals bounce / why am I confused with someone else) rather than by the auditor's internal categories.

evidence_metric.description: Name of the producer metric that carries this mode's headline evidence, used verbatim as the finding's evidence. Without it the evidence is a dump of every metric observed on the page, which buries the fact that actually demonstrates the problem.

kind.description: 'defect': something is wrong with the site; appears in findings and counts against the score. 'limitation': something the audit could not check; reported under audit_limitations and never scored, because a brand must not lose points for a tool the auditor lacked.

signal_type.description: 'field': observed on the real site as a visitor or crawler would meet it. 'lab': a controlled proxy standing in for a real-world property it cannot observe directly. Kept distinct so a proxy is never read as a measurement of the thing it proxies.

rationale.description: Why this matters, in brand terms.

action.description: What to do, written for the site owner.

suppressed_by.description: Failure modes whose own remediation already covers this ground. When any of them fired, the opportunity is dropped to avoid saying the same thing twice.
